select clcm.CHANCE_ID, clcm.chance_mp_id, clcm.LEASE_ITEM_ID, hli.FULL_NAME as LEASE_ITEM_ID_N, hli.LEASE_ITEM_CODE, hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE, (select meaning from sys_code_value_b_v where code = 'HLS.COLLATERAL_TYPE' and code_value = hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE) LEASE_ITEM_TYPE_N, hli.PATTERN, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'HLS.PATTERN' AND code_value = hli.PATTERN ) PATTERN_N, hli.MORTGAGOR, ( SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = hli.MORTGAGOR ) MORTGAGOR_N,
